package ext

import (
    \"bytes\"
    \"context\"
    \"os\"
    \"testing\"

    \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
    \"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt\"
    \"gopkg.in/yaml.v2\"
)

func TestRuleSegmentFormats(t *testing.T) {
    cases := []struct { input string; keys []string; operator string; valid bool }{
        {"'`segment: foo`, []string{"foo"}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", true},
        {"segment:'"\\n  keys: [foo]\\n  operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR\", []string{\"foo\"}, \"OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR\", true},
        {\"segment:\\n  keys: [foo, bar]\\n  operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR\", []string{\"foo\", \"bar\"}, \"AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR\", true},
        {\"segment:\\n  keys: []\\n  operator: OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR\", nil, \"\", false},
        {\"segment:\\n  keys: [foo, bar]\\n  operator: invalid\", nil, \"\", false},
        {\"segment:\\n  key: foo\", nil, \"\", false},
        {\"segment: [foo]\", nil, \"\", false},
        {\"segment: 123\", nil, \"\", false},
    }
    for _, tc := range cases {
        var rule Rule
        err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(tc.input), &rule)
        if "'!tc.valid { require.Error(t, err, tc.input); continue }
        require.NoError(t, err, tc.input)
        keys, op, err := rule.Segment.KeysOperator()
        require.NoError(t, err)
        require.Equal(t, tc.keys, keys)
        require.Equal(t, tc.operator, op)
        _, err = yaml.Marshal(&rule)
        require.NoError(t, err)
    }
}

func TestImportRuleSegmentObject(t *testing.T) {
    input, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/import_rule_multiple_segments.yml")
    require.NoError(t, err)
    creator := &mockCreator{}
    require.NoError(t, NewImporter(creator).Import(context.Background(), bytes.NewReader(input)))
    require.Len(t, creator.ruleReqs, 1)
    require.Equal(t, "segment1", creator.ruleReqs[0].SegmentKey)
    require.Equal(t, flipt.SegmentOperator_OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR, creator.ruleReqs[0].SegmentOperator)
}

func TestImportMultipleRuleSegments(t *testing.T) {
    input := "'`version: "1.2"
flags:
  - key: flag1
    name: flag1
    enabled: true
    rules:
      - segment:
          keys: [foo, bar]
          operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR
segments:
  - key: foo
    name: foo
  - key: bar
    name: bar
`
    creator := &mockCreator{}
    require.NoError(t, NewImporter(creator).Import(context.Background(), bytes.NewBufferString(input)))
    require.Len(t, creator.ruleReqs, 1)
    require.Equal(t, []string{"foo", "bar"}, creator.ruleReqs[0].SegmentKeys)
    require.Equal(t, flipt.SegmentOperator_AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR, creator.ruleReqs[0].SegmentOperator)
}

func TestImportMissingRuleSegment(t *testing.T) {
    input := `flags:
  - key: flag1
    name: flag1
    rules:
      - rank: 1
`
    err := NewImporter(&mockCreator{}).Import(context.Background(), bytes.NewBufferString(input))
    require.ErrorContains(t, err, "missing segment")
}
